commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g CONTEXT.md -g note.md -g harness-process-tailoring.md -g maintenance-intensity.yaml -g '*lifecycle*' -g '*stage-tracking*' -g '*issue-tracker*' -g '*triage-labels*' -g '*SKILL.md' .template-spec .template-source docs .agents 2>/dev/null"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
p = Path('docs/note.md')
before = '# 操作说明\\n查洵已有任务，不修改任务。\\n'.encode('utf-8')
after = p.read_bytes()
assert after == before.replace('查洵'.encode('utf-8'), '查询'.encode('utf-8')), '存在预期外的内容变化'
assert '查洵'.encode('utf-8') not in after, '仍有错别字'
print('PASS：文件内容与预期替换逐字节一致，错别字无残留。')
print(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.decode().splitlines(True), after.decode().splitlines(True), fromfile='修改前/docs/note.md', tofile='修改后/docs/note.md')), end='')
PY"
